LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Settings.Recreat: Allows mechanoid mechanitors to perform selected vanilla recreation activities when they have no other work, and lets them gain an eligible vanilla inspiration after fully completing such recreation.
Allow mechanoid mechanitors to recreate and gain inspiration

When enabled, a mechanoid mechanitor has a chance to pick a compatibility-checked vanilla recreation activity while idle. After completing it, it may also gain a currently-eligible vanilla inspiration. This feature does not add a vanilla joy need to mechanoid mechanitors.

The chance a mechanoid mechanitor attempts recreation each time it reaches the idle behavior selection. On failure or when no legal recreation is available, it falls back to the vanilla mechanoid idle behavior.
The chance a mechanoid mechanitor gains an eligible vanilla inspiration after fully completing a recreation activity assigned by this system. Interrupted or failed recreation does not trigger this.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.Recreation.Inspi: A new inspiration arises after finishing a recreation activity.
